import sys, json, hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

def H(extra=None, callid='c1', cseq=1, frm='<sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t'):
    h = [("From",frm),("To","<sip:bob@lab.test>"),("Call-ID",callid),("CSeq","%d MESSAGE"%cseq)]
    if extra: h.extend(extra)
    return h

def decisions_of(doc):
    out = decisions(doc)
    if isinstance(out, tuple): raise SystemExit('exit %s' % (out,))
    return out

def summary(doc):
    out = decisions_of(doc)
    return [(r['decision'], r.get('reason'), r.get('first')) for r in out['results']], (out['accepted'],out['replayed'],out['rejected'],out['live'])

# 1 replay
